name: painel-gerenciador-sites-express
description: Painel de gerenciamento dos projetos captados no Google Drive e publicação dos sites via GitHub Actions + FTP

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install && node scripts/motor.mjs install
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run test && npm --prefix web run test && node scripts/motor.mjs run test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix web run lint:api
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck && node scripts/motor.mjs run typecheck
